description.value: RiverHouse is a family-owned restaurant, pub, and marina on the banks of the Fraser River that has served the Delta community since 1997. It features what it describes as the largest heated patios in Delta, with sweeping waterfront views and year-round sunsets alongside an active marina. Touring cyclists on River Road will find a full-service destination with a genuine sense of local character in the heart of Ladner.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active full-service restaurant, pub, and marina at 6255 River Road, Delta, BC, operating since 1997, with phone 604-946-7545; OSM assigns the community as Richmond and lists postal code V4K 5E3, both contradicted by the website (Delta, V4K 0B2). No bike-specific amenities, washroom references, takeout options, or water-refill mentions appear anywhere in the website content, so all cycling-infrastructure fields are null. The waterfront location on River Road — a well-travelled Delta cycling corridor — with large heated patios and an on-site marina makes this a plausible and appealing stop for touring cyclists.
